## VERIFIED GREEN — live run `30964805133`

```
PASSED test_outbound_clear_parent_round_trips
```

Run `30964805133` at `c3fb869ab5`, conclusion **success**, **62 passed / 0 failed** across the whole
live external suite. This cell had FAILED in 12/12 runs; it passes on the first run after the
re-home.

### What the green proves, specifically

The Epic Link clear round-trips **through a real reconcile pass**, with the parent primed by a
LOCAL rebar edit so `should_propagate_removal` sees a MANAGED ref. That was this ticket's own
analysis and it held. It also confirms the answer to the blocking unknown by the strongest
available evidence — the operation the probe was built to test now runs end to end in production
code paths.

The sibling pin `test_a_subtask_reparent_is_REFUSED_rather_than_silently_ignored` is also green,
so the sub-task limit this cell was re-homed AWAY from is still asserted. The re-home moved the
oracle to a reachable mechanism without dropping the constraint.
